header.title: Muse UFO-A
header.description: Executable source-derived UFO-A endurant, type, dependence, mereology, constitution and quality package.

definition.text: An individual without spatiotemporal qualities in its own right.
A specialization of non sortal used to represent anti-rigid non-sortal in UFO-A.
A specialization of sortal used to represent anti-rigid sortal in UFO-A.
A rigid non-sortal.
A substantial unified by a membership structure.
A rigid sortal that supplies an identity principle for collective instances in UFO-A.
A type whose instances are collective entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A type whose instances are comparative relationship entities as characterized in UFO-A.
An individual that exists in space-time.
A mode whose manifestation is a perdurant.
A concrete individual that persists through time while possibly changing.
A type whose instances are endurants.
Anything admitted by the ontology.
A mode that depends on an entity independent of its bearer.
A collective whose membership is fixed over its relevant lifetime.
An object unified by a functional structure in which its components play distinct functional roles.
An entity that cannot itself be instantiated.
A moment depending on exactly one bearer.
A type whose instances are intrinsic moment entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A rigid sortal that supplies an identity principle.
A type whose instances are material relationship entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A semi-rigid non-sortal.
An intrinsic moment that is not modeled as a quality.
A rigid sortal that supplies an identity principle for mode instances in UFO-A.
A type whose instances are mode entities as characterized in UFO-A.
An endurant existentially dependent on a bearer.
A type whose instances are moment entities as characterized in UFO-A.
An endurant type whose instances need not share one identity principle.
A substantial unified by a functional structure.
A rigid sortal that supplies an identity principle for object instances in UFO-A.
A type whose instances are object entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A concrete individual that unfolds or occurs in time.
A type whose instances are perdurants.
An anti-rigid sortal defined by an intrinsic contingent condition.
An anti-rigid non-sortal defined by an intrinsic contingent condition.
The sum of externally dependent modes sharing a bearer, dependence source, and foundational event.
An abstract quality value.
An intrinsic moment associated with a value in a quality structure.
A one-dimensional quality structure.
A multidimensional quality structure.
A rigid sortal that supplies an identity principle for quality instances in UFO-A.
A non-empty set organizing quality values.
A type whose instances are quality entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A maximally topologically self-connected portion of matter.
A rigid sortal that supplies an identity principle for quantity instances in UFO-A.
A type whose instances are quantity entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A type whose instances are relationship entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A relational moment composed of mutually dependent qua individuals that mediates endurants.
A rigid sortal that supplies an identity principle for relator instances in UFO-A.
A type whose instances are relator entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A specialization of non sortal used to represent rigid non-sortal in UFO-A.
A specialization of sortal used to represent rigid sortal in UFO-A.
An anti-rigid sortal defined by a relational contingent condition.
An anti-rigid non-sortal defined by a relational contingent condition.
A specialization of non sortal used to represent semi-rigid non-sortal in UFO-A.
A sortal applying necessarily to some, but not all, of its instances.
An abstract individual determined by its members.
An endurant type whose instances share an identity principle.
A rigid sortal inheriting its identity principle from one kind.
An endurant that does not inhere in another entity.
A type whose instances are substantial entities as characterized in UFO-A.
A specialization of abstract individual used to represent temporal entity in UFO-A.
An abstract temporal boundary with no temporal duration.
An abstract temporal region bounded by temporal instants.
An entity that may classify individuals or lower-order types.
A collective whose membership is variable over its relevant lifetime.

ufo:associatedWith.definition: Holds from a quality type to a quality structure when the source is associated with the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:characterizedBy.definition: Holds from a endurant type to a moment type when the source is characterized by the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:componentOf.definition: Holds from a object to a object when the source is component of the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:constitutedBy.definition: Relates distinct entities of the same broad category in a constitution relation.

ufo:containsQuale.definition: Holds from a quality structure to a quale when the source contains quale the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:existentiallyDependsOn.definition: Whenever the dependent exists, the dependee exists.

ufo:externallyDependsOn.definition: Relates an externally dependent mode to an external dependee.

ufo:functionsAs.definition: Holds from a object to a type when the source functions as the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:hasComponent.definition: Holds from a object to a object when the source has component the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:hasLife.definition: Holds from a endurant to a perdurant when the source has life the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:hasMember.definition: Holds from a collective to a substantial when the source has member the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:hasProperPart.definition: Holds from a entity to a entity when the source has proper part the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:hasQuaIndividualPart.definition: Holds from a relator to a qua individual when the source has qua-individual part the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:hasUltimateBearer.definition: Holds from a moment to a substantial when the source has ultimate bearer the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:hasValue.definition: Relates a quality to exactly one quale.

ufo:inheresIn.definition: Relates a moment to its bearer.

ufo:instantiates.definition: Relates an individual or lower-order type to a type it instantiates.

ufo:manifests.definition: Relates an endurant or disposition to a perdurant that manifests it.

ufo:mediates.definition: Relates a relator to an endurant it mediates.

ufo:memberOf.definition: Holds from a substantial to a collective when the source is member of the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:overlaps.definition: Holds from a entity to a entity when the source overlaps the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:projectsTo.definition: Holds from a quality to a quale when the source projects to the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:properPartOf.definition: Irreflexive proper parthood derived from parthood.

ufo:quaIndividualOf.definition: Holds from a qua individual to a endurant when the source is qua individual of the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:specializes.definition: Relates a subtype to a supertype whose instances necessarily include its instances.

ufo:subCollectionOf.definition: Holds from a collective to a collective when the source is subcollection of the target, as defined in UFO-A.

ufo:subQuantityOf.definition: Holds from a quantity to a quantity when the source is subquantity of the target, as defined in UFO-A.
